visual_inspection.method: Viewed rendered captures through image tool, separating full-size figure review from embedded-page inspection. Automated matrix checks covered all 49 views; manual review sampled the listed captures and every reader-facing figure.
corrections: Replaced tall/wide automated reader-facing architecture with compact model-equivalent icon layout.
Wrapped five-step overview labels to retain readable embedded labels.
Moved hand-authored architecture branch labels away from arrows.
Inserted opaque edge-label backgrounds after observing lines behind state and flow labels.
Normalized SVG serialization and captured figures through HTML image embeds.
visual_inspection.result: No remaining observed clipping, missing icons/glyphs or arrow-through-label defects in inspected reader-facing exports. Source/behavior review retained separate production, verification and evidence states.

gates.method: Compared source-described nodes/edges, screenshot origin and captions; no product changes.
check.py heading levels plus manual reader-path review.
Computed rendered theme/style foreground/surface pairs using sRGB relative luminance; decorative pale borders excluded.
Individual figures and embedded captures inspected; text bounds measured. Full-size links plus adjacent text serve narrow-screen reading.
All 49 views loaded with no document overflow or failed images; sampled actual narrow/medium/desktop and CSS zoom captures.
Light/dark previews preserve bounded opaque light figure surfaces; no native theme-adaptation claim.
SVG title/description, Markdown alt/captions, visible icon/status labels and textual equivalents checked.
Editable sources, config, versions, exact icon data/license, reproduction command and source/output hashes retained.

limitations: Local CSS Markdown preview, not the actual VS Code webview.
200% uses CSS zoom:2 on the whole document, not browser UI zoom or physical screen scaling.
49 views checked automatically; manual image inspection is sampled as listed, not a reader study.
Figures shrink at 360/768px; explicit full-size links and equivalent adjacent text are required alternatives.
The automatic architecture Mermaid export is a source/model view; the reader-facing SVG uses its separately editable designed layout.
No general WCAG certification, runtime reacceptance, package publication or user-effectiveness claim.
